text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I went through all six of Moss's notes in the shared files and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *"Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth"* (North digest, 5 Oct 2025)
   - Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay assignments by text at the gatehouse kiosk.
   - Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the problem was gone.
   - A follow-up said to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.

2. **#4419**, from *"Moss: North cheat sheet"* (North digest, no date)
   - Thea Ramaswell opened it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift.
   - It was escalated to tier-2 product support so they could test the scanner firmware.

Moss's other notes don't have any other QFL ticket numbers. The QFL entries in the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in don't cite a ticket. The Central notes list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL.

Before you publish: #4419 has no date on it, and it doesn't share a number with PD-4492, even though both involve Door 14 at the gatehouse. It might be a separate issue or a different way of referring to the same ticket. I can't tell which from the notes, so it's worth checking with Thea or support. Also, watch the name: Quarendon Freightways (one "r") is a different company and isn't a customer, so keep it out of the notes.
